title: The broken wire
prompt: A 6 V loop with one resistor reads 0 A.
explanation: The whole 6 V appears across a break, because nothing else drops any voltage. The resistor reads 0 V since no current flows.

lines: 0 A means there is no complete path
So something in the loop is open (a break)
Across the break, the meter reads 0 V
Across the resistor, the meter reads 0 V
